tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Local knowledge for one Garden Route town: free/paid activities, hidden gems, dorm prices with booking links, evenings, safety tips and NSRI links.

tools.name: generate_itinerary
tools.description: Build a day-by-day Garden Route itinerary (west to east, no repeated activities) with per-day costs, a budget check with warnings, dietary verification, safety notes and transport estimates. Costs are in South African rand.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Usage statistics for this API (call counts, recent calls).
